description: Remove cards (widgets) from a portal's dashboard — one or SEVERAL in ONE call: pass every card that goes in item_ids (all of them when the person asks for all; every card not kept when they keep only some). The person confirms them all on one card; nothing is removed before that. Every card must be on that dashboard, or nothing is removed and the answer names its cards. Only the cards go; the tables, reports and charts they showed stay.

item_id.description: One card, from list_dashboard_items (item_ids takes several)

item_ids.description: Every card that goes, ids from list_dashboard_items

name: delete_dashboard_item
